text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day after training with Maruzensky,
another racer timidly
approaches us.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uh... Um, excuse me! H-h-hi, Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Heheh, don't be so nervous. You're
Special Week, right? The
new transfer
student?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! Um, um, your running is really
great! You run like you've got plenty of
energy to spare, but you're so fast... I
really want to run just
like you do!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Made me think that if I want to be the top
racer in all of Japan, I
need to be that fast
too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The top of Japan? My dear, is that your
dream?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! It is!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I really want Mom and Mama to see me
become the greatest racer in
all of Japan.
That's why I left Hokkaido to come here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well,
that's great. I think it's a wonderful
dream. I hope you make it
someday! I'll be
cheering for you, Spe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Um,
i-if it's all right...
Could we run together
sometime?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to run with you! Please,
it'd mean
so much!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: With me? Uh, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let me go check my schedule! I'll let you
know ASAP. Sound good?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh wow, of course! Okay, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Catch you on the flip side. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Like me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Maruzensky seems to be lost in the
occasional thought during
our training
talk.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I lost focus.
I've been thinking
circles about what Spe said.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I mean, I wouldn't mind at all,
you
know? How could I not help
out a cute
little trainee?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But, you know...
Spe has this crystal clear
dream of hers.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I can't imagine I'd be any help to a
bright-eyed kid like that...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
sorry! It's so strange—I always seem
to get like this when I'm
with you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
sorry! It's so strange—I always seem
to get like this when I'm
with you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She has faith in me,
and as a role model, I
can't let her down! Would
it be okay to go
for that run with Spe?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She has faith in me,
and as a role model, I
can't let her down! Would
it be okay to go
for that run with Spe?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks. ♪ Then let's go find her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She sounds happy about it, but I see some
hesitancy in her step. She must still be
unsure if she can live up to younger
racers'
aspirations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But she needn't worry, because the part of
her Special Week and the
others draw
aspiration from is...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? What's the hold up? Let's get a
move on!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? What's the hold up? Let's get a
move on!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Getting to the point, we're on for a pair
run! How's this evening
sound?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's great! Thank you! I can't
believe I get to run with the
amazing
Maruzen... I won't let you down!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now... You don't have to be so
serious, home skillet. It's just me
after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Uh, Trainer? What are you asking...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Uh, Trainer? What are you asking...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You mean what do I admire most about
her? Well, obviously she's a
really strong
racer and all that...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But the biggest thing is... no matter the
race, she always looks like
she's having
fun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You know how racers in the Twinkle Series
inspire runners
everywhere?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I too came here to make my mom proud
and give people hope... And
I think
Maruzen does that better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's strong, fast, and loves racing. It's
amazing to watch, and so
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Spe...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh no! It's my turn to clean the
classroom today! Sorry, gotta go! I
won't
be late for our run though!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, s-sure. See you later.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer... you're really something.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer... you're really something.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, playing dumb, huh? Hmph, fine...
Geez, I can't believe you
though.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, playing dumb, huh? Hmph, fine...
Geez, I can't believe you
though.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She said I give her hope and that my joy
for running inspires her...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll look totally uncool if I back out
after
that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky seems to be in a great mood
as she and Special Week run
together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... Wow, you really are amazing... I can't catch up at all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Watch carefully, Spe. I'm about to put the
pedal to the metal.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We're just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wooow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky shows the younger racer an
impressive run before
returning.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't even break a sweat. I'm still
ready for more. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I can't stand around dawdling if I'm going
to inspire the younger
generation!
